C1096.title: Shanxi Exposes 11 Typical Illegal Advertising Cases
C1096.summary: The Shanxi Provincial Market Supervision Administration publicly exposed 11 typical illegal advertising cases involving false claims and consumer deception, identified as malicious advertising practices by the regulatory authority.
